b: My usual bid strategy is Target ROAS, however recent performance has dropped significantly. Campaigns are not spending their daily budget and actual ROAS is nowhere near the Target ROAS. It seems a lot of advertisers are experiencing a decline in performance recently, from what I’ve been reading.
Because of this I changed my bidding strategy to Maximise Conversion Value, however this just resulted in high CPC, burning through the budget in a handful of clicks with little to no conversions.

This week, I thought I would try Maximise Conversion to see how that performs in comparison. This has just resulted in very low CPC, but spending double the daily budget. I checked where the clicks were coming from and 99% was YouTube. This is a feed only PMax campaign targeting products, why Google thinks cheap clicks from YouTube would convert I don’t know.
It’s one extreme to the other, Max Conversion Value results in expensive clicks which quickly burn through the budget, Max Conversions results in very cheap clicks whilst also burning through budget.
Note the change from tROAS to Maximise Conversion Value was done over a couple of weeks to give it chance to learn. The Maximise Conversion test only ran a couple of days.
What are your thoughts on this? Anyone experiencing the same results? What is the correct bid strategy? Because at the minute nothing seems to work.
